parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: Subscription
parameters.query:
Resources
| summarize by subscriptionId
| project value=subscriptionId, label=subscriptionId, selected=true
| order by label asc

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project value=id, label=id, selected=false, group=resourceGroup
| order by label asc

parameters.name: AppGateways
parameters.label: Application Gateway
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.network/applicationgateways'
| project value=id, label=name, selected=true, group=resourceGroup
| order by label asc

content.json:
## Application Gateway WAF and traffic

Choose a time range, **subscription**, **Log Analytics workspace**, and one or more **Application Gateways** above. The subscription selection feeds the workspace and gateway pickers. All subscriptions and gateways are selected by default; adjust the selectors to narrow the workbook. This workbook queries the **resource-specific** `AGWAccessLogs` and `AGWFirewallLogs` tables in the selected workspace. Enable the Application Gateway access and firewall diagnostic categories and send them to this workspace.

content.title: Traffic and response summary
content.query:
let Summary=materialize(AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize Requests=count(), Gateways=dcount(_ResourceId), ServerErrors=countif(HttpStatus between (500 .. 599)), ClientErrors=countif(HttpStatus between (400 .. 499)), AvgGatewayTimeMs=round(avg(TimeTaken) * 1000.0, 1), P95GatewayTimeMs=round(percentile(TimeTaken * 1000.0, 95), 1));
union
(Summary | project Metric="Total requests", Value=toreal(Requests), Context="Requests"),
(Summary | project Metric="Application Gateways", Value=toreal(Gateways), Context="Selected scope"),
(Summary | project Metric="4xx responses", Value=toreal(ClientErrors), Context="Client errors"),
(Summary | project Metric="5xx responses", Value=toreal(ServerErrors), Context="Server errors"),
(Summary | project Metric="Average total time", Value=AvgGatewayTimeMs, Context="Milliseconds"),
(Summary | project Metric="P95 total time", Value=P95GatewayTimeMs, Context="Milliseconds")

content.title: WAF activity summary
content.query:
let Summary=materialize(AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| extend ActionNorm=tolower(Action)
| summarize WafEvents=count(), BlockEvents=countif(ActionNorm in ("blocked", "detected and blocked", "jschallengeblock")), BlockedTransactions=dcountif(TransactionId, ActionNorm in ("blocked", "detected and blocked", "jschallengeblock")), MatchedRuleEvents=countif(ActionNorm == "matched"), DetectionOnlyEvents=countif(ActionNorm == "detected"));
union
(Summary | project Metric="WAF log events", Value=toreal(WafEvents), Context="All actions"),
(Summary | project Metric="Blocked transactions", Value=toreal(BlockedTransactions), Context="Distinct requests"),
(Summary | project Metric="Block rule events", Value=toreal(BlockEvents), Context="Blocking actions"),
(Summary | project Metric="Matched rule events", Value=toreal(MatchedRuleEvents), Context="Contributing matches"),
(Summary | project Metric="Detection-only events", Value=toreal(DetectionOnlyEvents), Context="Not blocked")

content.title: Traffic disposition
HTTP response distribution
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| extend StatusGroup=strcat(tostring(toint(HttpStatus / 100)), "xx")
| summarize Requests=count() by StatusGroup
| order by StatusGroup asc

content.title: Top blocking rules
content.query:
AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| where tolower(Action) in ("blocked", "detected and blocked", "jschallengeblock")
| extend Rule=iff(isempty(RuleId), Message, strcat(RuleId, " - ", Message))
| summarize Blocks=count() by Rule
| top 8 by Blocks desc

content.title: Requests over time
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize Requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: WAF block events over time
content.query:
AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| where tolower(Action) in ("blocked", "detected and blocked", "jschallengeblock")
| summarize BlockEvents=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
## All traffic

Access-log view of requests handled by Application Gateway. `TimeTaken` is end-to-end request time and can include client network, gateway, and backend time; it isn't gateway processing time alone.

content.title: Request volume by HTTP status
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize Requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), StatusGroup=strcat(tostring(toint(HttpStatus / 100)), "xx")
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: HTTP response distribution
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| extend StatusGroup=strcat(tostring(toint(HttpStatus / 100)), "xx")
| summarize Requests=count() by StatusGroup
| order by StatusGroup asc

content.title: Request volume by listener
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize Requests=count() by Listener=iff(isempty(ListenerName), "(unknown)", ListenerName)
| top 10 by Requests desc

content.title: End-to-end and WAF evaluation latency
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize AvgEndToEndMs=avg(TimeTaken) * 1000.0, P95EndToEndMs=percentile(TimeTaken * 1000.0, 95), AvgWafEvaluationMs=avg(WafEvaluationTime) * 1000.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: Top backend pools by request volume
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize Requests=count(), AvgBackendLatencyMs=round(avg(ServerResponseLatency) * 1000.0, 1), FailedRequests=countif(HttpStatus >= 500 or ServerStatus >= 500) by BackendPool=iff(isempty(BackendPoolName), "(unknown)", BackendPoolName)
| top 10 by Requests desc

content.title: Requests, errors, and latency by gateway
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize Requests=count(), ClientErrors=countif(HttpStatus between (400 .. 499)), ServerErrors=countif(HttpStatus between (500 .. 599)), AvgTimeMs=round(avg(TimeTaken) * 1000.0, 1), P95TimeMs=round(percentile(TimeTaken * 1000.0, 95), 1), AvgWafEvaluationMs=round(avg(WafEvaluationTime) * 1000.0, 1) by Gateway=tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| order by Requests desc

content.title: Recent requests
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| project TimeGenerated, Gateway=tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1]), ClientIp, Host, HttpMethod, RequestUri, HttpStatus, ServerStatus, WafMode, WafPolicyId, ListenerName, BackendPoolName, ServerRouted, TimeTaken, WafEvaluationTime, ErrorInfo, TransactionId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.json:
## Blocked traffic and rule-level reasons

The detail grid shows the blocking WAF event **and** any `Matched` rule events for the same transaction. `Message` identifies the rule/event; `DetailedMessage` explains the match; `DetailedData` shows the request value that matched. A transaction can produce multiple rows because multiple rules can contribute to a block. Treat request data in these fields as sensitive.

content.title: Blocked requests by rule
content.query:
AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| where tolower(Action) in ("blocked", "detected and blocked", "jschallengeblock")
| summarize BlockEvents=count(), Transactions=dcount(TransactionId), Clients=dcount(ClientIp) by RuleId, Message, RuleSetType, RuleSetVersion, PolicyScope, PolicyScopeName
| order by BlockEvents desc

content.title: Blocked transactions: blocking event and contributing rule matches
content.query:
let BlockedTransactions=AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| where tolower(Action) in ("blocked", "detected and blocked", "jschallengeblock")
| where isnotempty(TransactionId)
| distinct _ResourceId, TransactionId;
let Access=AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| where isnotempty(TransactionId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, HttpStatus, ServerStatus, TimeTaken, ListenerName, BackendPoolName, ServerRouted) by _ResourceId, TransactionId
| project _ResourceId, TransactionId, HttpStatus, ServerStatus, TimeTaken, ListenerName, BackendPoolName, ServerRouted;
AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| extend ActionNorm=tolower(Action)
| where ActionNorm in ("blocked", "detected and blocked", "jschallengeblock", "matched")
| where isnotempty(TransactionId)
| join kind=inner BlockedTransactions on _ResourceId, TransactionId
| join kind=leftouter Access on _ResourceId, TransactionId
| extend EventRole=iff(ActionNorm == "matched", "Contributing rule match", "Blocking event"), Reason=strcat(Message, " | ", DetailedMessage, iff(isnotempty(DetailedData), strcat(" | Matched data: ", DetailedData), ""))
| project TimeGenerated, Gateway=tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1]), ClientIp, Hostname, RequestUri, EventRole, Action, RuleId, RuleSetType, RuleSetVersion, PolicyScope, PolicyScopeName, Message, DetailedMessage, DetailedData, Reason, HttpStatus, ServerStatus, TimeTaken, ListenerName, BackendPoolName, ServerRouted, TransactionId, PolicyId, FileDetails, LineDetails
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.title: Top client IPs by blocked transactions
content.query:
AGWFirewallLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| where tolower(Action) in ("blocked", "detected and blocked", "jschallengeblock")
| summarize BlockEvents=count(), Transactions=dcount(TransactionId), Rules=make_set(RuleId, 10), Paths=make_set(RequestUri, 5) by ClientIp
| order by Transactions desc

content.json:
## Gateway metrics (derived from access logs)

These panels use `AGWAccessLogs` for request volume, response codes, end-to-end latency, WAF evaluation time, and backend response details. They are request-log measurements, not Azure Monitor platform metrics. For native metrics such as **Healthy Host Count**, **Unhealthy Host Count**, **Capacity Units**, and **CPU Utilization**, use the Application Gateway resource's **Metrics** blade; those metrics aren't all exported to Log Analytics.

content.title: End-to-end and WAF evaluation latency
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize AvgEndToEndMs=avg(TimeTaken) * 1000.0, P95EndToEndMs=percentile(TimeTaken * 1000.0, 95), AvgWafEvaluationMs=avg(WafEvaluationTime) * 1000.0, P95WafEvaluationMs=percentile(WafEvaluationTime * 1000.0, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: Backend response codes
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| where isnotnull(ServerStatus)
| summarize Responses=count() by BackendStatus=tostring(ServerStatus), BackendPoolName
| order by Responses desc

content.title: Backend latency and connection time by pool
content.query:
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({AppGateways})
| summarize Requests=count(), AvgBackendResponseMs=round(avg(ServerResponseLatency) * 1000.0, 1), P95BackendResponseMs=round(percentile(ServerResponseLatency * 1000.0, 95), 1), AvgBackendConnectMs=round(avg(ServerConnectTime) * 1000.0, 1), FailedRequests=countif(HttpStatus >= 500 or ServerStatus >= 500) by Gateway=tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1]), BackendPoolName, BackendSettingName
| order by FailedRequests desc
